entries.test: Contemporaneous news coverage and public commentary would show whether the predominantly favorable narrative about Altman in November 2023 had substantially shifted toward criticism by May 22, 2024.
entries.note: The claim concerns the public narrative, not whether literally everybody loved Altman.

entries.test: Public posts and commentary available by May 22, 2024 would show whether numerous people expressed substantially similar critical assessments of Altman.
entries.note: The surrounding text supplies the subject and critical direction of the perceptions. The referenced posts are absent from the supplied text, limiting verification but not checkability.
